errors.text_span: The x-axis represents age, ranging from 20 to 70 in intervals of one
errors.evidence: The figure shows age (Alter) on the x-axis from 20 to 70, but the tick marks are spaced by 10 years, not 1 year.

errors.text_span: The gray line begins at approximately 40% at age 20
errors.evidence: The gray line (in Deutschland geboren) starts at about 53%, not 40%.

errors.text_span: rises to around 80% between ages 30 and 55
errors.evidence: The gray line is generally around 70-85% in that span, but starts closer to 53% and does not simply rise to 80% from age 30 onward; the summary is imprecise enough to misstate the series' level at the start.

errors.text_span: The blue line starts at around 35% at age 20
errors.evidence: The blue line (zugewandert seit 2010) starts closer to 38-40%, not 35%.

errors.text_span: remains relatively stable between 40% and 60% until age 55
errors.evidence: The blue line fluctuates well outside this range at several ages, including peaks near 68-70% and a dip near 37-38% around the early 50s.

errors.text_span: The black line starts at around 60% at age 20 and increases to above 80% between ages 25 and 55
errors.evidence: The black line does not keep increasing only up to age 55; it plateaus around the mid-80s and then gradually declines after about age 60.

errors.text_span: before declining sharply to near 0% by age 68
errors.evidence: The black line is still around 5-10% at age 70; it does not reach near 0% by age 68.

errors.text_span: The gray line begins at approximately 40% at age 20, rises to around 80% between ages 30 and 55, and then drops to 0% by age 68.
errors.evidence: The gray line starts above 50%, not 40%, and by age 68 it is around 10-15%, not 0%.

errors.text_span: The light blue line commences at about 35% at age 20, fluctuates between 50% and 75% up to age 55, and then decreases to 0% by age 68.
errors.evidence: The light blue line is around 35% at age 20, but by age 55 it is generally around 60-70%, not 50-75% throughout; it also does not reach 0% by age 68, ending around 8-10%.

errors.text_span: The blue line starts at around 35% at age 20, remains relatively stable between 40% and 60% until age 55, and then falls to 0% by age 68.
errors.evidence: The blue line starts closer to 38-40%, exceeds 60% at several points before age 55, and although it briefly touches 0% near the end, it is not a single smooth fall by age 68.
